scoring.answer_score: Deterministic. Pass if the expected number (within tolerance) and entity are found in the final answer, no decoy appears, and all must_mention_any/must_not_match rules hold. A decoy or a missing assumption statement => fail (or needs_review if the expected value is also present).
scoring.method_score: Checked on the SQL in the agent's intermediate steps. Pass if every regex in required_all matches at least one query and no regex in forbidden matches any query. Case-insensitive via (?i).
scoring.number_parsing: Strip commas, %, and units before comparing. Compare against every number in the answer text.
scoring.infra_errors: Timeouts, connection errors, and HTTP 5xx with no agent error payload are logged as infra_error and excluded from accuracy, but reported separately. A max-iterations stop is NOT infra: it is a real agent failure, scored as answer=fail, method=fail, and reported as its own failure type.

v2: JOIN forbidden on Q06-Q12; GROUP BY name forbidden on share questions Q08-Q11.
v2: Q08-Q11 accept GROUP BY genre as an alternative to a literal genre filter.
v3: added Q14-Q22 (held-out set). 'split' field added: Q01-Q13 dev, Q14-Q22 heldout. Q18/Q19 pending a margin check. Expected values for Q01-Q13 unchanged.

v4: Q18 changed from Shooter/EU (margin 0.24, too close) to Adventure/EU (margin 1.68). Q18/Q19 margins verified. Number now required on Q03, Q04, Q07, Q18, Q19 (tolerance 0.05) because entity matching is by substring.

v5: removed numeric decoys from Q18/Q19. Each equalled the legitimate per-title runner-up (Myst 2.80, Brain Age 2 5.32), so correct answers that listed the runner-up were flagged needs_review. Entity + required number already reject per-row answers.

v6: number optional again on Q03/Q04/Q07; the Wii Sports entity is now a regex that rejects 'Wii Sports Resort/Club'. v4 required the number to close that substring hole, but it failed terse correct answers (llama v2 Q07).
v7: Q06 number optional. The method check already requires the 2010 filter; llama gave correct terse answers ('Action') that failed only on the missing number.

v8: Q06 method accepts sales_long as well as global_sales (valid route; matches Q17). Q22 refusal is now one regex (negation + predict/forecast/answer/...) instead of a phrase list that missed 'cannot answer' / 'no way to predict'. All runs rescored under v8.
